content.text:
Resubmitted with the drafting cleanup applied.

**What changed this round:**
- **Section 8.3 relettered cleanly** — the amended sentence now reads "the earliest to occur of **(a)** a termination under Section 7.7, **(b)** the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full ... and **(c)** the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement." Two tight replacements handle the insertion and the (b)→(c) renumber; every other word of the clause is preserved verbatim.

**What I declined, and why:**
- **Conditioning the exit on appointment of a Successor Servicer.** That would convert the preferred element's *unconditional* Customer convenience right into a qualified one, handing the Servicer a practical veto over our exit — a weakening of our position and a term outside the checklist. Sections 7.3 and 7.4 already require the Servicer to continue performing until the date stated in the notice and oblige the Indenture Trustee to engage (or become) a Successor Servicer on any termination "under this Agreement", so the transition concern is already covered by retained language. Worth raising as a negotiation point if the Servicer or a Rating Agency pushes back, but not something to concede in our first draft.

**Position held:** preferred level; element 4 `already_met` on retained Section 7.1; no "in whole or in part", no survival tail, expense, procedure or extra remedy; Sections 7.2(c), 7.3, 7.4 and 7.6 untouched. The deterministic "Customer convenience termination present: false" reflects the pre-redline document — which is precisely the deviation being cured.
